mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, leading to increased economic activity, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate and a decrease in the consumer price index indicates a tightening monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which drives down stock prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate and an increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of low unemployment and high payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales and a decrease in the unemployment rate indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of high retail sales and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).
